review:
Smokey goes ice fishing. Winning spots become Golden Squares, and when a Rainbow lands they reveal coins, green or gold clovers, buckets or global buckets – buckets collect from the 3x3 around them, global buckets from the whole grid.

Epic Rainbows reveal special symbols on every position. In the On Thin Ice bonus, Golden Squares stay lit until they're used, so they build up through the round. The fishing branch of the Le family, with a 15,000x max and lots of collecting.
